member.name: T:NaturalGasPipeline.Mechanics.SteelPipeDesign
member.summary:
Internal-pressure design of steel line pipe (Barlow thin-wall hoop stress with code factors):
P = (2·S·t / D) · F · E · T
P design pressure (GAUGE), S SMYS, t nominal wall thickness, D nominal outside diameter, F design factor, E longitudinal joint factor, T temperature derating factor. Source: 49 CFR §192.105 (verified); same form as ASME B31.8 §841.1.1.
Scope and limits: - Internal pressure only. External loads, corrosion allowance and mill under-tolerance are NOT included; the code requires extra thickness for external loads not to be counted in P (49 CFR §192.105(a)). - Uses outside diameter (Barlow, conservative for thin walls); intended for D/t ≳ 20. Below that a warning is returned by . - P is a gauge pressure. The hydraulic engine works in absolute pressure: use / at the boundary. - Design pressure is not the MAOP: the MAOP is also limited by the hydrostatic test pressure divided by the class test factor, by the weakest component (flanges, valves) and by regulation. Only the pipe-strength limit is computed here.

member.name: T:System.Runtime.CompilerServices.ModuleInitializerAttribute
member.summary: Used to indicate to the compiler that a method should be called in its containing module's initializer.
member.remarks:
When one or more valid methods with this attribute are found in a compilation, the compiler will emit a module initializer which calls each of the attributed methods.
Certain requirements are imposed on any method targeted with this attribute: - The method must be `static`. - The method must be an ordinary member method, as opposed to a property accessor, constructor, local function, etc. - The method must be parameterless. - The method must return `void`. - The method must not be generic or be contained in a generic type. - The method's effective accessibility must be `internal` or `public`.
The specification for module initializers in the .NET runtime can be found here: https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/design/specs/Ecma-335-Augments.md#module-initializer
